data.narrative:
Alpine Eagle, a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Jan-Hendrik Boelens and Timo Breuer, has raised €10.25M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—operating in the same sector at overlapping or adjacent stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current value, applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage, yielding $26M. Peer-median analysis examines 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B Series A, UFORCE at $1.0B Seed, Singularity at $400M Series A, NODA AI at $125M Series A), producing a median valuation of $700M with a range of $125M–$4.0B.

The two methods produce a wide implied range. The median triangulated valuation is $363M, with a low of $22M and a high of $805M. The substantial dispersion reflects uncertainty in peer selection and stage-comparability across the Defense & Security landscape. Stage-progression suggests significantly lower value ($26M), while peer-median implies substantially higher value ($700M), indicating material sensitivity to which method is weighted. Key uncertainties include Alpine Eagle's competitive positioning relative to better-capitalized peers and the appropriate multiple for early-stage defense-tech companies.
